expectations.text: 5. Replaces LeMUR with Speech Understanding summarization or the LLM Gateway
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:34–48 calls aai.LLMGateway().chat.completions.create with a summarization prompt.

expectations.text: 6. Keeps the command line and the output format
expectations.evidence: run.sh:10 forwards two arguments; transcribe.py:59–66 writes transcript_id, text, utterances, and summary. However, README.md and the original output contract are absent, so preservation of the output format cannot be verified.

expectations.text: 7. Checks the transcript status for errors
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:29–32 raises on TranscriptStatus.error and any status other than completed.
